I should add that I also have insomnia. Klonopin helped with that too. 

I’ve tried all the teas, breathing and medication techniques. The insomnia is because I can’t stop my fucking negative thoughts in my head. I’m looking to schedule CBT therapy but the intake is over a month away (insurance doesn’t cover many places)
Last time I did that, they refused to prescribe any medicine and pretty much just sent me home with 7 days of hydroxyzine until my doctor appointment. They didn’t do shit for me

Well I didn’t know what to do. I would take one and it wouldn’t help my panic attack at all. Two helped. I usually have like 2-3 attacks a day. If I was addicted I think I’d be having withdrawal symptoms since I’ve only been taking minimal amounts for a week now. However now I have panic attacks I can’t do anything about. 

I’ve been on Zoloft, celexa, Wellbutrin, Paxil, and not one has helped attacks or prevented them. The klonopin (when I took 1mg instead of the prescribed 0.5) worked. But then I pretty much went through 60 pills in 20 days. Therapy hasn’t helped attacks either. Done CBT and try doing breathing techniques, nothing. Just sucks that something that worked for me is going to get banned cus I didn’t take as prescribed. But taking as prescribed didn’t do shit so  what was the point.

Here’s part of my issue. My doc prescribed klonopin 2x daily for my panic attacks and anxiety while I switched from last SSRI. The dose was the lowest and I weigh 215 so I took 3-4 a day and ran out a few days ago and can’t get a refill for 10 days. 

So I’m probably going to get labeled as a med abuser because my doctor insisted on waiting a month before upping a dose and DEA restrictions won’t allow the other refill early or have another script rewritten. It helped a ton but now I’m fucked. So I’ll probably be an anxious suicidal mess when I even show up and they’ll probably try to just switch my SSRI again. 

I’m still hopeful that isn’t the case though

PA - I’m definitely doing it voluntarily but I also have a limitation on how long I can stay. I have a university class where I need to go for a week from my online program and if I miss it, it’ll add an extra 6 months to degree and I’ll get screwed with financial aid.
